PMBrain 1.4.51 removes the new global default chat timeout. Entity ingest has separate configurable call/job deadlines; truncation recovery respects known output/context ceilings, actual remaining cost/tokens and final verification reserves without consuming normal tool rounds. Abort causes and per-page usage/limits are retained; Ollama stream errors preserve tool rejection for durable JSON fallback.

PMBrain 1.4.53 adapts Cherry context-management ideas in the Workbench: per-request budgets, immutable tool shares, structural output trimming and full-exchange compaction. Gateway request shaping is opt-in; readonly concurrency is explicit, capped at four, preserves result order and persist-before-execute for each tool. Default callers, non-idempotent writes and crash replay stay serial. Ollama native tools receive bounded context windows; reasoning-only output is not a tool answer. No knowledge data/schema, Core retrieval, Minion phases or upstream-pinned hashes are changed.

PMBrain 1.4.54 adds opt-in request lifecycle boundaries, same-request stream recovery and per-endpoint validated JSON/DSML tool normalization. Canonical tool history is preserved while Workbench uses a budgeted projection with one output reservation and a protocol-free final answer. Existing Core/Minion timeout, replay, write ordering and default serial execution remain unchanged. No knowledge schema/data, retrieval or upstream-pinned hash changes.

PMBrain 1.4.57 removes cross-document cumulative entity-capture input/output token ceilings and owner-task token allowance subtraction. Token usage, owner-linked monetary budgets, completed ingest receipts, per-document limits, request timeouts, bounded truncation retry and resource guards remain. Legacy total-token settings are retained but ignored; API ceilings are null. No knowledge schema/data or upstream-pinned hash changes.

PMBrain 1.4.58 scopes ingest turns and token allowance to each chunk. Durable distinct entity references extend the default eight-turn allowance up to the existing shared Minion twenty-turn ceiling; duplicate entity operations do not extend it. Explicit operator turn limits remain. Exhausted chunk turns or tokens leave that document pending while subsequent documents continue; monetary limits and provider/resource stops still bound the task. Successful chunks and original Source/evidence checks remain reusable. No new loop, knowledge schema/data or upstream-pinned hash changes.

PMBrain 1.4.72 prepares entity embeddings before the guarded write transaction, merges fact deltas deterministically, and writes only changed ordinary Markdown chunk rows. Explicit ingest-only read concurrency is bounded at two with durable persist-before-execute and ordered results; writes and chunk jobs remain serial. Phase counts, remaining children and elapsed time reuse the persistent product task projection. Existing Source, revision, evidence, budget and phase-order rules remain; the upstream coordinator and managed filesystem are not imported.

PMBrain 1.4.74 projects the existing ingest, filing and quality contracts for pre-imported entity capture. Verified content-addressed chunk receipts retain Source incarnation, page identity, model and contract dependencies; preserved fact-line proofs and graph reconciliation gate reuse. Product capture permits at most two model requests and one mutating tool at a time with a 32 MiB active-input window; pressure or unknown sampling shrinks admission to one, and priced finite monetary caps retain serial requests. CLI defaults, the PGLite owner, durable queue/lease, source evidence, native validation and phase order remain. Model wait/attempt/error stages use existing task progress; certificate errors retain their original message. No new upstream subsystem, schema migration or production backfill is introduced.
